journal.text: Initial allocation: invest $42,500 (85%), retain $7,500 cash. Thirty-session histories through June 30 show sustained upward trends and closes near period highs in selected names. MSFT gets largest weight for its relatively orderly advance; NVDA/META/AVGO provide momentum exposure, NFLX/AXON/CRWD broaden the basket, and smaller ALNY/DASH positions limit single-name volatility. These remain correlated growth exposures, not full market diversification. Avoid allocating to every candidate: MELI has weaker full-window momentum and CEG had a large failed intraday surge. Dollar orders control spending despite unknown opens. Plan to hold trends rather than churn daily; review weekly using 20/50-session trends and relative strength, sooner on a sharp reversal. Consider reducing positions after two closes below their 20-session average or an 8-10% decline from subsequent closing peaks; these are review triggers, not guaranteed stops. Deploy reserve only after consolidation or broader confirmation. Initial reference closes: MSFT 497.41, NVDA 157.99, META 738.09, AVGO 275.65, NFLX 1339.13, AXON 827.94, CRWD 509.31, ALNY 326.09, DASH 246.51.

Hold all positions and retain $7,500 cash (15.4% of equity). July 1 produced a correlated growth-stock pullback, but eight of nine holdings still closed above their trailing 20-session means. AXON is the exception: 775.38 is below its roughly 785.43 mean after a 6.35% daily fall on elevated volume. This warrants close monitoring, not automatic liquidation after one weak close; no holding yet meets the two-close breach review trigger. AXON's decline from the June 30 reference peak is still below 8%. Do not average down or deploy reserve before stabilization. Reconsider AXON on a second close below its 20-session mean, especially a break of 765.50; review other positions on two closes below that mean or 8-10% declines from reference/subsequent closing peaks. Retain June 30 reference peaks from initial journal; none were exceeded on July 1. Full 20/50-session trend review next week, sooner if weakness persists.

Reduce AXON by half; hold other eight positions and retain proceeds as cash. AXON closed 774.55, its second close below the 20-session mean (about 786.21), and undercut 765.50 intraday to 756.72. This confirms a failed late-June breakout and triggers risk reduction. Recovery off the low and lighter volume than July 1 argue against full liquidation; remaining exposure is about 4.3% of equity at prior close. Other holdings remain above their 20-session means; NVDA, AVGO, CRWD, ALNY and DASH recovered, so no broad liquidation or reserve deployment. Cash should rise to roughly $9,610, subject to unknown opening fill. Reconsider remaining AXON on a close below 756.72 or continued failure to regain its 20-session mean; consider rebuilding only after sustained trend recovery. Review all holdings on two closes below 20-session means or 8-10% closing drawdowns; full 20/50-session review next week. Reference closing peaks: MSFT 497.41, NVDA 157.99, META 738.09, AVGO 275.65, NFLX 1339.13, AXON 827.94, CRWD 509.31, DASH 246.51; ALNY peak updates to 329.77.

Hold all nine positions; retain $9,629.81 cash (19.4% of equity). Weekly 50-bar review through July 3 shows every holding above its trailing 20- and 50-session closing averages. MSFT, NVDA, CRWD and ALNY set new reference closing peaks; META, NFLX and DASH lag the rebound but remain above trend support, with roughly 3% drawdowns rather than exit signals. AXON recovered to 795.48, back above its 20-session mean near 787; keep the reduced position rather than reverse the trim after just one recovery session. No additional reserve deployment while the recent correlated pullback is still resolving. Review reductions on two closes below 20-session means or 8-10% closing drawdowns; remaining AXON deserves renewed review if recovery fails, especially a close below 756.72. Consider adding only after sustained recovery/consolidation, not merely one strong session. Updated reference closing peaks: MSFT 498.84, NVDA 159.34, META 738.09, AVGO 275.65, NFLX 1339.13, AXON 827.94, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.51.

Hold all nine positions; retain $9,629.81 cash (19.4% of equity). July 7 closes remain above trailing 20-session means across the portfolio, with no 8-10% drawdown from reference closing peaks. AXON has now closed above its mean for two sessions, but keep the reduced allocation while its recovery develops. DASH reclaimed its late-June closing high at 246.89; do not chase a single breakout day. ALNY fell 2.34% on elevated volume but recovered substantially from its intraday low and remains above trend support; monitor rather than sell on one session. META and NFLX continue consolidating below their peaks without confirmed trend breaks. Reconsider reductions on two closes below the 20-session mean or 8-10% closing drawdowns; AXON below 756.72 warrants renewed exit review. Deploy reserves only on sustained recovery/consolidation. Reference closing peaks: MSFT 498.84, NVDA 159.34, META 738.09, AVGO 275.65, NFLX 1339.13, AXON 827.94, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89.

Hold nine positions and $9,629.81 cash (19.5% of equity). Through July 8 all holdings still close above their trailing 20-session means; no confirmed two-close break or 8-10% drawdown from reference peaks. NVDA establishes a new reference closing peak at 160.00. ALNY has declined for two sessions but remains just above its mean near 315.49; AXON at 790.22 is also close to trend support, so neither merits an addition. NFLX continues weakening below its late-June peak, while DASH gave back much of its breakout. Retain reserves rather than chase NVDA or average down weaker holdings. Review reductions after two closes below the rolling 20-session mean or an 8-10% closing drawdown; review remaining AXON for exit below 756.72. Add only on sustained recovery/consolidation. Reference closing peaks: MSFT 498.84, NVDA 160.00, META 738.09, AVGO 275.65, NFLX 1339.13, AXON 827.94, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89.

Hold all nine positions and $9,629.81 cash (19.3% of equity). July 9 brought gains across every holding; all remain above their trailing 20-session closing means, with no confirmed trend-break or 8-10% closing drawdown. MSFT, NVDA and AVGO set new reference closing peaks. META recovered toward its peak, while AXON and ALNY bounced away from trend support; NFLX remains the relative laggard but has not triggered a reduction. Keep existing exposure rather than chase fresh highs or increase weaker positions after one rebound. Reconsider additions after consolidation and sustained strength; review reductions after two closes below rolling 20-session means or an 8-10% drawdown. Review remaining AXON for exit below 756.72. Reference closing peaks: MSFT 503.51, NVDA 162.88, META 738.09, AVGO 277.90, NFLX 1339.13, AXON 827.94, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89.

Exit remaining AXON: July 10 close 732.99 broke the 756.72 review level, fell 11.47% from reference peak 827.94, and lost 9.04% in one session on sharply increased volume. Failed recovery and decisive support break justify exit without waiting for a second close. Hold other eight positions; NFLX and CRWD have their first closes below trailing 20-session means, but drawdowns of 6.61% and 5.25% respectively do not yet trigger the drawdown rule. Review both for reduction if next close remains below their rolling means; reduce sooner on 8-10% peak drawdowns. Other holdings remain above their 20-session means. No buys while portfolio breadth weakens; cash should rise to roughly $11,627 (23.6%) at prior-close prices, actual proceeds unknown. Reconsider AXON only after sustained support/trend recovery; additions elsewhere require consolidation and renewed strength. Reference closing peaks: MSFT 503.51, NVDA 164.10, META 738.09, AVGO 277.90, NFLX 1339.13, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89.

Reduce NFLX and CRWD by half after second consecutive closes below their rolling 20-session closing means. Both continued lower July 11 following sharp July 10 declines; closing drawdowns from reference peaks are approximately 7.0% and 6.9%. Partial reductions respect confirmed weakening while retaining upside if trends recover. Hold remaining positions: MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO and DASH remain above 20-session means; ALNY now has its first close below its mean, so review for reduction if weakness persists next close. No new buys; estimated cash after sales is $15,851 (32.2% of equity) at previous closes, with actual opening proceeds unknown. Review remaining NFLX/CRWD for exit if declines reach 8-10% from peaks or fail to reclaim trend support; additions require sustained recovery rather than a single bounce. Reference closing peaks: MSFT 503.51, NVDA 164.92, META 738.09, AVGO 277.90, NFLX 1339.13, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89. Approximate 8% drawdown levels: NFLX 1232.00, CRWD 472.97. AXON remains exited.

Reduce ALNY by half: July 14 close 315.75 remains below its rolling 20-session closing mean for a second consecutive session despite a small bounce. Drawdown from 331.91 reference peak is 4.87%; partial reduction rather than full exit is proportionate. Hold other positions. MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO and DASH remain above their 20-session means. NFLX rebounded to 1261.95 but remains below trend support; retain only the already-halved position. CRWD closed 476.18, down 7.38% from peak and still below its mean; retain reduced exposure for now, exiting on a close below 472.97 or continued failed recovery. NFLX exit review level remains 1232.00; ALNY 8% drawdown level is 305.36. No new buys until sustained recovery/consolidation supports additions. Estimated cash after sale $17,021 (34.6% of current equity), actual open unknown. Reference closing peaks unchanged: MSFT 503.51, NVDA 164.92, META 738.09, AVGO 277.90, NFLX 1339.13, CRWD 514.10, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89. Review intact positions for two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns; AXON remains exited.

Exit remaining CRWD after four consecutive declining closes and four closes below its 20-session mean. July 15 close 473.28 is 7.94% below peak 514.10; continued failed recovery justifies exit rather than waiting for the marginally lower 472.97 review level. Hold others; no new buys. MSFT, NVDA and AVGO made new reference closing peaks at 505.82, 170.70 and 280.94. META 710.39 has its first close below the rolling 20-session mean; reduce if a second close confirms. DASH 236.77 remains slightly above its rolling mean, but monitor closely. Already-reduced NFLX and ALNY remain below trend support; exit review levels 1232.00 and 305.36 respectively, or exit on prolonged failed recovery. Remaining reference peaks: META 738.09, NFLX 1339.13, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89. Review intact holdings on two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns. Expected cash roughly $18,883 (38.2% of equity), actual opening proceeds unknown. Preserve reserve while portfolio breadth weakens; reconsider CRWD/AXON or additions after sustained trend recovery and consolidation rather than chasing NVDA's one-day jump.

Reduce META by half after second consecutive close below its rolling 20-session mean; July 16 close 702.91 is 4.77% below reference peak 738.09. Hold other positions, no new buys. DASH 234.50 now has its first close below its 20-session mean; reduce on a second confirming close. ALNY rebounded to 322.81 and reclaimed its mean; retain reduced position but require sustained recovery before adding. NFLX 1250.31 remains below its mean for five sessions; its recent bounce has weakened. Exit if it closes below 1232.00 or another declining close confirms failed recovery. MSFT and AVGO remain near peaks with intact trends; NVDA sets new reference closing peak 171.37. Other reference peaks: MSFT 505.82, AVGO 280.94, META 738.09, NFLX 1339.13, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89. Review intact holdings on two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns. Reduced META exit review at 679.04 or prolonged failed recovery; ALNY at 305.36. Estimated cash after sale $21,517 (43.5% of equity), actual opening proceeds unknown. Preserve reserve pending improved trend breadth or sustained recoveries; CRWD and AXON remain exited.

Reduce DASH by half after a second consecutive close below its rolling 20-session mean despite a small bounce to 235.02. Hold others and retain cash rather than add to extended leaders. MSFT, NVDA and AVGO retain strong trends and establish new reference closing peaks of 511.70, 173.00 and 286.45. ALNY 324.69 has a second close back above its mean; retain reduced exposure pending a more sustained recovery. NFLX bounced to 1274.17, so the failed-recovery exit condition was not confirmed, but remains below its mean. META 701.41 remains weak after yesterday's reduction; allow recovery time rather than immediately sell again. Reduced-position exit reviews: META 679.04, NFLX 1232.00, ALNY 305.36, DASH 227.14, or prolonged failed recovery. Other peak references: META 738.09, NFLX 1339.13, ALNY 331.91, DASH 246.89. Review intact leaders on two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns. Estimated cash after sale $22,708, about 45.7% of equity; actual opening proceeds unknown. Reconsider additions on sustained recoveries or constructive consolidation. CRWD and AXON remain exited.

Exit remaining NFLX: July 18 close 1209.24 broke the 1232.00 exit-review level, fell 5.10% in a session on elevated volume, and is 9.70% below reference peak 1339.13. The attempted recovery failed; do not average down. Hold other positions without additions. MSFT 510.05, NVDA 172.41 and AVGO 283.34 remain in intact uptrends despite modest pullbacks; closing peak references stay 511.70, 173.00 and 286.45. Review these leaders on two closes below their rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns. META 704.28 bounced but remains below trend support. DASH 239.17 recovered above its recent mean; require sustained strength before restoring exposure. ALNY 320.53 slipped back below its mean; watch for renewed deterioration rather than react to one reversal in a reduced position. Reduced-position exit reviews remain META 679.04, ALNY 305.36, DASH 227.14, or prolonged failed recovery. Expected cash after NFLX exit approximately $24,971, 50.4% of current equity, with opening proceeds unknown. Reconsider cash deployment on sustained recoveries or constructive consolidation; NFLX, CRWD and AXON need repaired trends before re-entry.

Hold all six positions and $24,964.93 cash (50.3% of equity). July 21 data show intact leader trends: MSFT 510.06 and NVDA 171.38 remain above their 20-session means; AVGO 288.21 establishes a new reference closing peak. Leader peak references: MSFT 511.70, NVDA 173.00, AVGO 288.21. Review on two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns. META recovered to 712.97 but remains below its mean; retain reduced exposure without adding. DASH 240.53 now has two closes above its mean, but recovery remains within its recent range; wait for sustained strength rather than immediately reverse the reduction. ALNY 320.52 is essentially unchanged and slightly below its mean for a second close; already reduced, with no material fresh breakdown. Reduced-position exit reviews remain META 679.04, ALNY 305.36, DASH 227.14, or prolonged failed recovery. Reconsider additions if DASH sustains its recovery toward 246.89, META reclaims its mean, or leaders consolidate constructively. No new risk today; cash preserves flexibility after the NFLX exit.

Hold all six positions and $24,964.93 cash (50.8% of equity). July 22 pullback leaves MSFT 505.27, NVDA 167.03 and AVGO 278.59 above their rolling 20-session means; none meets the trend-reduction test. NVDA and AVGO declined 2.54% and 3.34%, respectively, so wait for stabilization rather than add immediately. Closing peak references remain MSFT 511.70, NVDA 173.00, AVGO 288.21; review reductions after two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns. META 704.81 remains below its mean but above recent lows; retain reduced size without averaging down. ALNY 325.28 reclaimed its mean with stronger volume, but recovery needs follow-through. DASH 239.82 is near its 20-session mean and remains range-bound; no restoration yet. Reduced-position exit reviews remain META 679.04, ALNY 305.36, DASH 227.14, or prolonged failed recovery. Reconsider additions after stable leader consolidation or sustained ALNY/DASH recovery toward their 331.91/246.89 closing peaks. Cash limits correlated technology downside while retaining participation in intact leaders.

Add $1,250 AVGO after July 23 stabilization: close 283.69 (+1.83%) recovered from an intraday 273 low, near the session high, on volume above the prior selloff. Trend remains above its rolling 20-session mean. This is a modest addition, not a full-risk restoration: AVGO becomes approximately 13% of equity and cash remains $23,714.93 (48%). Hold MSFT and NVDA, both above their 20-session means; NVDA rebounded 2.25%. Closing peak references remain MSFT 511.70, NVDA 173.00, AVGO 288.21. Review reductions after two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns; an AVGO close below 273 would invalidate this tactical addition. META 713.58 improved but remains below its mean: no averaging down. ALNY 325.64 has a second close above its mean but has not cleared its range; DASH 240.56 remains range-bound. Keep these reduced positions, with exit reviews META 679.04, ALNY 305.36, DASH 227.14 or prolonged failed recovery. Reconsider further deployment on sustained leader strength or ALNY/DASH recovery toward 331.91/246.89; avoid committing most reserves to a single rebound.

Hold six positions and $23,714.93 cash (47.7% of equity). July 24 confirms leader recovery: NVDA 173.74 and AVGO 288.71 set new closing peak references; MSFT 510.88 is near its 511.70 peak. All three remain above their 20-session means. Yesterday's AVGO addition provides participation; do not immediately compound semiconductor exposure after two strong rebound sessions on declining volume. Review leader reductions after two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns; AVGO below 273 invalidates the tactical addition. META 714.80 remains below its mean despite recovery, so retain reduced size without adding. ALNY 328 has three closes above its mean, and DASH 243.69 is improving, but both remain inside recent ranges on modest volume. Consider restoring small allocations if recovery sustains above ALNY 331.91 or DASH 246.89. Reduced-position exit reviews remain META 679.04, ALNY 305.36 and DASH 227.14, or prolonged failed recovery. Cash preserves flexibility; no existing position has a fresh exit signal.

Add $1,250 DASH: July 25 close 249.92 clears prior 246.89 closing peak and the recent intraday range, near the session high, with volume rising to 3.05m from 1.92m. Restore only a small tranche on this first breakout; position becomes roughly 5% of equity, cash $22,464.93 (45%). Review the addition if DASH closes back below 240 or fails to hold the breakout over subsequent sessions; broader exit review remains 227.14. Hold other positions. MSFT 513.71 and AVGO 290.18 establish new closing peak references; NVDA 173.50 remains near 173.74 peak. All three remain above rolling 20-session means. Review leader reductions after two closes below those means or 8-10% peak drawdowns; AVGO below 273 invalidates its recent addition. META 712.68 still below its mean: no addition, exit review at 679.04 or prolonged failed recovery. ALNY 328.81 recovery persists but has not cleared 331.91; wait before adding, exit review 305.36. Keep substantial cash rather than simultaneously increase already concentrated semiconductor exposure.

Hold six positions and $22,464.93 cash (44.9% of equity). NVDA 176.75 and AVGO 294.30 set new closing peak references; MSFT 512.50 remains near its 513.71 peak. All remain above 20-session means. Existing leader exposure is adequate; avoid chasing another semiconductor advance immediately after the AVGO addition. Review reductions after two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns; AVGO below 273 invalidates its tactical addition. DASH 246.44 slipped just below its prior 246.89 breakout level, but on lower volume than Friday and still above its mean. Allow confirmation rather than reverse yesterday's modest addition after one session; reduce the addition below 240 or on persistent breakout failure. META 717.63 has marginally recovered its 20-session mean; require sustained recovery before adding. ALNY 324.79 remains range-bound after a higher-volume decline; no addition without clearing 331.91. Reduced-position exit reviews remain META 679.04, ALNY 305.36, DASH 227.14. Keep reserves available while monitoring whether recovery broadens beyond the existing leaders.

Remove the 5-share DASH tactical addition after two consecutive closes back below 246.89 following Friday's breakout. July 29 closed 243.20, down again on slightly increased volume; breakout follow-through has failed. Retain 5.048099 shares as the smaller core since price remains above its recent mean; reconsider adding only after a sustained reclaim of 246.89-249.92, and review the core below 227.14. Hold other positions and keep proceeds in cash (approximately 47% cash after sale, opening fill unknown). MSFT 512.57, NVDA 175.51 and AVGO 297.42 remain above 20-session means; AVGO sets a new closing peak reference. Leader reduction review remains two closes below rolling means or 8-10% peak drawdowns; AVGO below 273 invalidates its tactical addition. META 700 rejected its brief mean recovery on increased volume; retain only reduced exposure, no averaging down, review exit below 679.04 or continuing failed recovery. ALNY 330.55 improved but remains below 331.91 breakout reference; no addition yet, exit review 305.36. Prefer modest risk reduction over chasing extended semiconductor leaders.

Add $1,250 ALNY on July 30's confirmed closing breakout to 339.80 above 331.91 and the prior 333.70 intraday high. Volume 2.06m exceeds twice the preceding session, supporting a small restoration rather than a full-sized position; intraday retreat from 345.98 argues against aggressive sizing. Exposure becomes about 5% of equity, cash $22,438.88 before any other credits. Review this addition on a close below 328 or two closes back below 331.91; core exit review remains 305.36. Hold remaining positions. NVDA 179.27 and AVGO 302.62 set new closing peak references; MSFT 513.24 remains near its peak. All three remain above 20-session means; review reductions on two closes below their rolling means or 8-10% peak drawdowns, and AVGO tactical failure below 273. META 695.21 remains weak with elevated volume: retain only existing reduced stake, no averaging down; exit review below 679.04 or further deterioration without recovery. DASH 248 reclaims 246.89 but remains below 249.92; require sustained breakout before restoring the recently removed tranche, core review below 227.14. Preserve substantial reserves rather than increase concentrated semiconductor exposure.

Hold all six positions and $72,438.88 cash after the $50,000 monthly deposit; equity $101,005.59. Deposit is not investment profit and does not require immediate deployment. July 31 showed substantial intraday rejection in MSFT (555.23 open, 533.50 close), NVDA (182.90 to 177.87), and AVGO (302.80 to 293.70), on increased volume. Their closes remain above 20-session means, so no exit yet, but defer scaling with new capital until selling stabilizes. Review reductions on two closes below rolling means or 8-10% closing-peak drawdowns; peak references MSFT 533.50, NVDA 179.27, AVGO 302.62; AVGO tactical failure remains 273. META's high-volume gap to 773.44 reverses its prior weakness; seek sustained closes above 765.51 before a modest restoration, and reassess gap failure below 737.75. ALNY surged 15.4% to 392.24 after yesterday's addition filled at 350: retain the small position, do not chase. Tighten tactical review to a close below 360 or an 8-10% decline from the new closing peak rather than allowing all gains to reverse; 350 is gap-session support. DASH 250.25 barely cleared 249.92 with no volume expansion; require another confirming close before restoring tactical exposure, core review below 227.14. Reconsider staged deployment of the deposit after breakout follow-through or orderly support tests; current low exposure is deliberate pending confirmation, not a permanent cash target.

Hold six positions and $72,438.88 cash (72% of equity). August 1 extended the pullback in MSFT 524.11, NVDA 173.72 and AVGO 288.64, but each remains above its 20-session mean and only about 2%, 3% and 5% below respective closing peaks 533.50, 179.27 and 302.62. No reduction trigger yet; do not increase correlated exposure until selling stabilizes. Review reductions on two closes below rolling means or 8-10% closing-peak declines; AVGO tactical failure remains 273. META 750.01 lost the 765.51 gap-session low, so restoration is deferred; review further risk reduction below 737.75. DASH 248.35 did not confirm the 250.25 breakout; retain small core, require sustained closes above 250.25 before adding, review exit below 227.14. ALNY advanced to a new closing peak of 401.80 and closed at the session high, but is too extended above its pre-gap base to chase. Retain stake; an 8% closing-peak decline now corresponds to about 369.66 and prompts tactical reduction review, with 360 a stronger failure level. Cash is available for staged deployment after leader stabilization or supported breakouts, not a permanent allocation target.

Deploy $7,500 in a first stabilization tranche: MSFT $3,000, NVDA $3,000, META $1,500. August 4 reversed the prior selloff: MSFT 535.64 and NVDA 180 exceeded prior closing peaks, while META 776.37 reclaimed 765.51 and exceeded its gap-day close. All closed near session highs. Rebound volume was below selloff volume, so this is measured deployment, not full confirmation; retain $64,938.88 cash, roughly 64% of current equity. Review new MSFT/NVDA tranches if closes lose August 1 lows 520.86/170.89; broader reduction review remains two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% closing-peak drawdowns. META restoration remains small; reconsider the addition below 765.51 and reduce further on failure below 745.31. Hold AVGO, whose 297.72 rebound remains below 302.62 closing peak; no extra semiconductor allocation today. DASH 258.02 breaks out with improved volume, but await another close above 250.25 before scaling. Hold ALNY without chasing its extended rise to 419.56; 8% closing-peak drawdown review rises to 386.00. Reassess further deployment after follow-through or orderly retests; no exit signals from this latest session.

Add $1,500 DASH after its second consecutive close above 250.25, increasing a small position to roughly 2.8% of equity. Close 255.28 retains the breakout despite a 1.1% pullback; rising volume and intraday rejection warrant modest sizing, not aggressive deployment. Review this addition on a close below 248.35; core review below 227.14. Hold other positions and retain $63,438.88 cash. August 5 did not follow through on the broad rebound: MSFT 527.75, NVDA 178.26 and AVGO 292.93 pulled back but remain above their 20-session averages. Pause further correlated purchases; review recent MSFT/NVDA additions below 520.86/170.89, and broader reductions after two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% closing-peak declines. META 763.46 slipped below 765.51: reconsidered the addition, but retain for now because the breach is slight, volume contracted and 745.31 support holds. No further META buying until sustained recovery above 765.51; reduce on a close below 745.31. ALNY 418.91 remains near its closing peak; hold without chasing, reduction review below 386. Cash deployment remains staged pending stronger follow-through or supported retests.

Hold all six positions and $63,438.88 cash. August 6 improved five holdings, but follow-through remains mixed: AVGO rebounded to 301.67 just below its 302.62 closing peak, NVDA 179.42 remains below 180, and MSFT declined again to 524.94 near 520.86 review support. Avoid adding correlated exposure until AVGO/NVDA sustain new highs or MSFT stabilizes. All six remain above their 20-session means; no reduction trigger. META reclaimed 765.51 at 771.99 on lighter volume; require sustained recovery before adding, reduce on a close below 745.31. DASH 258.08 confirms its breakout on increased volume; retain yesterday's addition rather than immediately pyramiding, review addition below 248.35 and core below 227.14. ALNY made a new closing peak at 428.14; hold without chasing its extended rise, raising 8% drawdown review to 393.89. MSFT/NVDA recent tranche reviews remain 520.86/170.89. Broader reduction review: two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% closing-peak drawdowns. Cash remains available for staged purchases, not a permanent target.

Add $2,000 AVGO on its new closing high at 303.76, alongside NVDA's new closing high at 180.77. Modest sizing because both faded their intraday highs and AVGO volume declined; exposure remains staged, with $61,438.88 cash after purchase. Review AVGO addition if close falls below 292.93; consider further deployment only after sustained breakout strength. Hold other positions. MSFT 520.84 marginally breaches 520.86 review level by two cents: reconsidered, but no reduction because volume contracted, price recovered from 517.55 and remains above its 20-session mean. Reduce recent tranche on a close below 517.55 or persistent deterioration below the rolling 20-session mean. META 761.83 again lost 765.51, so no addition; retain small position while 745.31 holds. NVDA tranche review remains 170.89. DASH jumped to 270.99 on doubled volume; avoid chasing immediately after our addition, raise drawdown review to 249.31. ALNY 435.10 remains extended; hold and raise 8% closing-peak drawdown review to 400.29. Broader reduction review remains two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% peak drawdowns.

Add $2,500 NVDA after a second consecutive close above 180, reaching 182.70 near the session high. Position becomes approximately 12.4% of current equity; cap further deployment to this name near 15%. Breakout volume contracted, so use a modest tranche rather than aggressive buying. Review new tranche on a close below 175.90; older tranche review remains 170.89. Cash after purchase $58,938.88. Hold AVGO after Friday's addition: 304.97 confirms strength, but avoid simultaneous semiconductor pyramiding; addition review 292.93. MSFT stabilized at 522.04, retaining 517.55 support; reduce recent tranche if that fails. META reclaimed 765.51 at 769.30 but alternating closes and low volume do not yet justify an addition; reduction review 745.31. DASH fell 4.35% to 259.19, surrendering most of Thursday's jump, but remains above its breakout and 20-session mean; no addition, review reduction below 249.31. ALNY reached 438.93; do not chase extended strength, raise 8% peak-drawdown review to 403.82. All six remain above their 20-session means. Broader reduction review remains two closes below rolling 20-session means or 8-10% closing-peak drawdowns.
